judgment_text:
Prayer : This contempt petition filed under Section 11 of Contempt of Courts Act, 1971 to punish the Respondents for having disobeyed and violated the order of this Court dated 26-6-2025 passed in W.P. No. 22683 of 2025

ORDER

This contempt petition has been filed seeking to punish the respondent for wilful disobedience of the order dated 26-6-2025 passed by this Court in W.P. No. 22683 of 2025.

2. Today, when the matter was taken up for hearing, learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that, the order under contempt has been complied with and he has also made an endorsement to that effect before this Court today.

3. In view of the above submission made by the learned counsel for the petitioner, this contempt petition stands closed.
